title: Can Rabbits Eat Lettuce?
description: It does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: Can Rabbits Eat Lettuce?
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage and rabbit food guides.
-->

<section class="rcl-page alignfull" id="can-rabbits-eat-lettuce">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rcl-page,
    .rcl-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main { background: #fef4f0 !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image { display: none !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rcl-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rcl-page a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    .rcl-page a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 10px; }

    .rcl-wrap { width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }
    .rcl-narrow { width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }

    .rcl-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rcl-pill::before { content: "✦"; color: var(--rc-gold); }

    .rcl-btns { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; align-items: center; margin-top: 30px; }

    .rcl-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcl-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }
    .rcl-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage)); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26); }
    .rcl-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); color: var(--rc-moss); border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10); }

    .rcl-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rcl-hero-image-wrap { width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #fff9ef; overflow: hidden; }
    .rcl-hero-cover { position: relative; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; }

    .rcl-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.68), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.24) 45%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcl-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rclFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rcl-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 720px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rcl-hero-title-overlay .rcl-pill { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); }

    .rcl-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rcl-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rcl-hero-content { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr; gap: 34px; align-items: center; padding-top: 44px; }
    .rcl-breadcrumb { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 18px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 800; }
    .rcl-breadcrumb a { color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }

    .rcl-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcl-hero-subtitle { max-width: 720px; margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem); }

    .rcl-hero-card,
    .rcl-side-card,
    .rcl-panel,
    .rcl-lettuce-card,
    .rcl-step,
    .rcl-benefit {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcl-hero-card { padding: 28px; border-radius: 38px; box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); }
    .rcl-hero-card h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.18; }
    .rcl-hero-card ul { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .rcl-hero-card li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: start; color: var(--rc-muted); font-weight: 700; }
    .rcl-hero-card li::before { content: "✓"; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-weight: 900; }

    .rcl-quickbar { position: relative; z-index: 4; margin-top: 26px; }
    .rcl-quickbar-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 14px; padding: 16px; border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88); border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12); box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); }
    .rcl-quick { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 96px; padding: 18px; border-radius: 24px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb); transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; }
    .rcl-quick:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14); }
    .rcl-quick-icon { width: 62px; height: 62px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 2.35rem; line-height: 1; }
    .rcl-quick strong { display: block; color: var(--rc-moss); line-height: 1.15; font-size: 1.02rem; }
    .rcl-quick span span { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.35; }

    .rcl-section { width: 100%; padding: 72px 0; position: relative; }
    .rcl-section-header { max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto 32px; text-align: center; }

    .rcl-section h2,
    .rcl-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcl-section-header p { margin: 0 auto; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.08rem; max-width: 680px; }
    .rcl-article-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px; gap: 28px; align-items: start; }
    .rcl-content { display: grid; gap: 24px; }

    .rcl-panel { position: relative; padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px); border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); overflow: hidden; }
    .rcl-panel::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 190px; height: 190px; right: -82px; top: -92px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10); pointer-events: none; }
    .rcl-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .rcl-panel h2 { margin-top: 0; }
    .rcl-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.45rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rcl-panel p { margin: 0 0 16px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.03rem; }
    .rcl-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .rcl-list { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 22px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .rcl-list li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr; gap: 12px; align-items: start; padding: 15px; border-radius: 20px; background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10); color: var(--rc-muted); font-weight: 700; }
    .rcl-list li::before { content: "✓"; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-weight: 900; }

    .rcl-lettuce-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .rcl-lettuce-card { padding: 24px; border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; }
    .rcl-lettuce-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15); }
    .rcl-lettuce-card b { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 54px; height: 54px; margin-bottom: 18px; border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-size: 1.5rem; }
    .rcl-lettuce-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.22rem; }
    .rcl-lettuce-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcl-warning { padding: 68px 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)); }
    .rcl-warning-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr; gap: 28px; align-items: center; padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px); border-radius: 42px; background: #ffffff; border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16); box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); }
    .rcl-warning-card h2 { color: var(--rc-danger); }
    .rcl-warning-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.06rem; }
    .rcl-warning-list { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .rcl-warning-list li { padding: 18px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--rc-danger-soft); color: #4a2823; font-weight: 800; }
    .rcl-warning-list strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--rc-danger); font-size: 1.05rem; }

    .rcl-image-split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr; gap: 30px; align-items: center; }
    .rcl-image-card { position: relative; min-height: 430px; }
    .rcl-image-card img { position: absolute; object-fit: cover; display: block; border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82); box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); transition: transform 0.35s ease; }
    .rcl-image-card img:hover { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important; }
    .rcl-img-main { width: 78%; height: 340px; left: 0; top: 20px; border-radius: 42px; transform: rotate(-2deg); }
    .rcl-img-small { width: 52%; height: 230px; right: 0; bottom: 0; border-radius: 34px; transform: rotate(4deg); object-fit: contain !important; background: #fff9ef; }

    .rcl-prep { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)); }
    .rcl-steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .rcl-step { padding: 24px; border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); }
    .rcl-step b { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; margin-bottom: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.15); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-size: 1.15rem; }
    .rcl-step h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.16rem; }
    .rcl-step p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcl-sidebar { position: sticky; top: 22px; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
    .rcl-side-card { padding: 22px; border-radius: 28px; }
    .rcl-side-card h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.18rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rcl-side-card ul { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .rcl-side-card a { display: block; padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff9ef; color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-weight: 850; transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; }
    .rcl-side-card a:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: #fff4d8; }

    .rcl-note { padding: 20px; border-radius: 24px; background: #ffffff; border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold); color: var(--rc-muted); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08); }
    .rcl-note strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    .rcl-benefits-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 24px; }
    .rcl-benefit { padding: 22px; border-radius: 26px; }
    .rcl-benefit h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.15rem; }
    .rcl-benefit p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcl-final { padding: 70px 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }
    .rcl-final-box { padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px); border-radius: 46px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)), url("/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-lettuce-2.png"); background-size: cover; background-position: center; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); overflow: hidden; }
    .rcl-final-box .rcl-pill,
    .rcl-final-box h2,
    .rcl-final-box p { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); }
    .rcl-final-box p { max-width: 780px; margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 1.08rem; }
    .rcl-final-box .rcl-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #2f4a2e; border: 2px solid #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22); text-shadow: none; }

    .rcl-related { padding: 74px 0; background: #fff9ef; opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; animation: none !important; }
    .rcl-related,
    .rcl-related * { opacity: 1 !important; filter: none !important; text-shadow: none !important; }
    .rcl-related .rcl-section-header { padding: 30px; border-radius: 34px; background: #ffffff; border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22); box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.14); }
    .rcl-related .rcl-section-header .rcl-pill { color: #4e6b45 !important; }
    .rcl-related .rcl-section-header h2 { color: #243320 !important; opacity: 1 !important; text-shadow: none !important; }
    .rcl-related .rcl-section-header p { color: #332d26 !important; opacity: 1 !important; text-shadow: none !important; font-weight: 650; }
    .rcl-related-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .rcl-related-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr; gap: 15px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 24px; background: #ffffff !important; border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22); box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15); transition: transform 0.22s ease, background 0.22s ease; }
    .rcl-related-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); background: #fff; }
    .rcl-related-card img { width: 92px; height: 92px; max-width: 92px; max-height: 92px; border-radius: 20px; object-fit: cover; background: #f1eadf; }
    .rcl-related-card h3 { margin: 4px 0 6px; color: #243320 !important; line-height: 1.15; font-size: 1.08rem; font-weight: 900; }
    .rcl-related-card p { margin: 0; color: #332d26 !important; font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.45; font-weight: 650; }

    .rcl-disclaimer { padding: 0 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }
    .rcl-disclaimer p { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72); color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.95rem; text-align: center; border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12); }

    .rcl-reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); animation: rclFadeUp 0.9s ease forwards; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry 12% cover 30%; }
    @keyframes rclFadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.985); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
    @keyframes rclFadeUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(26px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .rcl-page *, .rcl-page *::before, .rcl-page *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
      .rcl-reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 980px) {
      .rcl-page { left: 50%; width: 100vw; margin-top: -90px !important; transform: translateX(-50%); }
      .rcl-wrap, .rcl-narrow { width: min(100% - 28px, var(--rc-max)); }
      .rcl-hero-content, .rcl-article-layout, .rcl-image-split, .rcl-warning-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .rcl-sidebar { position: static; order: -1; }
      .rcl-quickbar-inner, .rcl-lettuce-grid, .rcl-benefits-grid, .rcl-related-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
      .rcl-steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .rcl-image-card { min-height: 420px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .rcl-page { left: 50%; width: 100vw; max-width: 100vw; margin-top: -90px !important; transform: translateX(-50%); overflow-x: hidden; }
      .rcl-wrap, .rcl-narrow { width: calc(100% - 24px); }
      .rcl-hero { padding: 0 0 28px; }
      .rcl-hero-title-overlay { left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 18px; padding: 18px; }
      .rcl-hero-title-overlay h1 { font-size: clamp(2.45rem, 13vw, 4rem); line-height: 0.92; }
      .rcl-hero-title-overlay p { font-size: 1rem; }
      .rcl-hero-content { padding-top: 30px; gap: 22px; }
      .rcl-quickbar-inner, .rcl-lettuce-grid, .rcl-benefits-grid, .rcl-related-grid, .rcl-steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .rcl-quickbar-inner { padding: 12px; border-radius: 24px; }
      .rcl-quick { grid-template-columns: 54px 1fr; min-height: 76px; padding: 14px; border-radius: 18px; }
      .rcl-quick-icon { width: 54px; height: 54px; font-size: 2.1rem; }
      .rcl-section, .rcl-warning, .rcl-related { padding: 46px 0; }
      .rcl-section h2, .rcl-final h2, .rcl-intro-heading { font-size: clamp(2rem, 11vw, 3rem); line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.045em; }
      .rcl-panel { padding: 22px; border-radius: 26px; }
      .rcl-list li { grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr; padding: 13px; }
      .rcl-list li::before { width: 32px; height: 32px; }
      .rcl-image-card { min-height: 0; display: grid; gap: 12px; }
      .rcl-img-main, .rcl-img-small, .rcl-image-card img { position: static; width: 100%; height: 230px; left: auto; right: auto; top: auto; bottom: auto; transform: none !important; border-radius: 24px; border-width: 6px; }

            <p>
              Lettuce is a common vegetable found in many kitchens, but many rabbit owners wonder whether it is safe for their pets. The good news is that rabbits can eat certain types of lettuce, and it can be a healthy addition to their diet when fed in moderation.
            </p>
            <p>
              However, not all lettuce varieties are suitable for rabbits, and some types should be avoided. In this guide, we’ll explain which lettuce is safe, how much rabbits can eat and how to feed it properly.
            </p>
          </section>

            <span class="rcl-pill">Safe leafy greens</span>
            <h2>Is lettuce safe for rabbits?</h2>
            <p>
              Yes, many types of lettuce are safe for rabbits and can provide hydration and nutrients. Lettuce contains vitamins and minerals that can support a rabbit’s health when included as part of a balanced diet.
            </p>
            <p>
              Lettuce should only be given as part of a varied selection of leafy greens, and it should never replace hay as the main part of a rabbit’s diet. Hay should still make up around 80–90% of a rabbit’s daily food intake.
            </p>

        <div>
          <span class="rcl-pill">Avoid iceberg lettuce</span>
          <h2>Lettuce to avoid</h2>
          <p>
            Iceberg lettuce should not be fed to rabbits. It has very little nutritional value and a high water content, which can contribute to digestive problems such as diarrhoea when eaten in larger amounts.
          </p>
        </div>

        <ul class="rcl-warning-list">
          <li>
            <strong>Low nutrition</strong>
            Iceberg lettuce offers very little nutritional value compared with better leafy greens.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Very watery</strong>
            Its high water content can upset a rabbit’s digestion if too much is eaten.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Lactucarium concern</strong>
            Iceberg lettuce contains lactucarium, which can be harmful to rabbits if consumed in large quantities.
          </li>
        </ul>
      </div>

          <h2>How much lettuce can rabbits eat?</h2>
          <p>
            Lettuce should be offered as part of a daily portion of fresh vegetables. A general guideline is about 1 cup of leafy greens per 2 pounds, or 1 kg, of rabbit body weight per day.
          </p>
          <p>
            Lettuce should be mixed with other greens rather than fed on its own. Variety helps create a more balanced diet and gives rabbits different textures and flavours.
          </p>

          <ul class="rcl-list">
            <li>Use safe lettuce as part of a mixed leafy green portion.</li>
            <li>Do not use lettuce to replace hay.</li>
            <li>Introduce new greens slowly to avoid digestive upset.</li>
            <li>Watch your rabbit’s poo, appetite and behaviour when adding new foods.</li>
